headline.title: Unlocking UK house-building with AI-accelerated planning
headline.summary: The UK government has partnered with Google DeepMind to develop an AI-powered prototype designed to accelerate housing planning decisions. This initiative aims to streamline the house-building process in the UK.

articles.title: SpaceX valuation balloons to $2.6T, briefly passes Amazon
articles.summary: SpaceX's valuation has surged to $2.6 trillion, briefly surpassing Amazon's market value. This increase of $1 trillion follows the company's shares beginning to trade on Friday.

articles.title: Apple 2027 rumors: AirPods with cameras for AI and the second folding iPhone
articles.summary: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports that Apple is planning to launch AirPods equipped with cameras by late 2027, aimed at enhancing AI capabilities. Additionally, the company is rumored to be developing a second folding iPhone model.

articles.title: Android 17 launches with new multitasking tools as Google expands Gemini features
articles.summary: Google has launched Android 17 and Wear OS 7, featuring enhanced multitasking tools, parental controls, and security upgrades. The release also includes a Pixel Drop that integrates the latest AI models into its devices.

articles.title: Plaud says its software business topped $100M in ARR after shipping over 2M AI notetakers
articles.summary: Plaud has announced that its software business has surpassed $100 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR) following the shipment of over 2 million AI notetakers. The company aims to establish a presence in the competitive market for AI-driven meeting documentation solutions.

articles.title: Robinhood’s note on 10% layoffs shows blaming AI isn’t cutting it
articles.summary: Robinhood's CEO Vlad Tenev announced a 10% workforce reduction without attributing the decision to AI, contrasting with other tech companies that have cited AI-driven restructuring as a reason for job cuts. This omission highlights a different approach to layoffs within the financial services sector.

articles.title: Qualcomm’s latest chip hints that more powerful smart glasses could be on the way
articles.summary: Qualcomm has unveiled its new Snapdragon Reality Elite chip, designed to enhance the performance of upcoming augmented and virtual reality devices. This development suggests that more advanced smart glasses may soon be on the market, as Qualcomm continues to innovate in the XR technology space.

articles.title: ‘Dangerous’ AI Models Are Coming No Matter What
articles.summary: The US government's efforts to regulate advanced AI models like Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 highlight the inevitability of increasingly sophisticated AI systems with hacking capabilities. Experts warn that such "dangerous" models will become commonplace despite regulatory attempts.

articles.title: Sixty percent of US consumers say ‘AI’ in brand messaging is a turnoff, survey finds
articles.summary: A recent survey by WordPress VIP reveals that 60% of US consumers find the inclusion of 'AI' in brand messaging off-putting, indicating a general skepticism towards AI-generated content. Despite this consumer sentiment, businesses continue to recognize AI search as a vital referral channel.

articles.title: SpaceX is public: Everything you need to know post-IPO
articles.summary: SpaceX has officially gone public, with TechCrunch providing comprehensive coverage of the company's IPO, including insights on potential winners and losers, pre-IPO deals, and details from its S-1 registration document. The article outlines the company's journey and what to expect in the post-IPO landscape.

articles.title: Probably raises $9M to build a more reliable kind of AI
articles.summary: Probably has secured $9 million in funding to develop AI technology aimed at reducing hallucinations and factual inaccuracies, striving for reliability comparable to deterministic systems. The company's goal is to enhance the trustworthiness of AI outputs for users.

articles.title: SpaceX is officially buying Cursor for $60 billion
articles.summary: SpaceX has announced its acquisition of Cursor for $60 billion, aiming to enhance its offerings in the enterprise sector and compete with AI companies like Anthropic and OpenAI. This move follows SpaceX's recent IPO and is part of a broader strategy to integrate AI capabilities into its diverse business operations.
